description: This file defines a React-like component using Qwik framework for rendering a recipes list page. It handles URL-based filtering, pagination, fetches recipe data from an API, and displays a grid of recipe cards with filtering tags and loading/error states.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Constructs a RecipeQuery object from the current URL search parameters to enable filtering and pagination.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Creates a new URL string with updated query parameters based on provided changes, preserving existing parameters.
